ModMetaData.name: RimAI.Communication.Personas
ModMetaData.author: Rabirinth
ModMetaData.description:
RimAI.Communication.Personas generates and maintains colonist personas for RimAI dialogue.
It reads genes, skills, relationships, and other pawn data, then offers distinct personality options. You can add director notes and turn individual data fields on or off.
Requires Harmony and RimAI.Communication. Gameplay text AI uses shared RimAI settings.
